subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 16, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - October 16, 2026**

**KDE Releases Documentary**

As part of KDE's 30th anniversary celebration, the project has released "The KDE Documentary". This documentary showcases the history and development of the KDE community, highlighting its impact on the world of open-source software. The documentary is a must-watch for anyone interested in the history of KDE and the open-source movement.

**Community News**

* Ubuntu 26.10 has been released, bringing new features and improvements to the popular Linux distribution.
* AlmaLinux has issued security updates for various packages, including environment-modules, flatpak-builder, and kernel.

**Practical Tip**

Did you know that you can customize the appearance of your AcreetionOS desktop with the Cinnamon theme manager? To access the theme manager, go to Settings > Themes > Cinnamon Theme Manager. From there, you can browse and install new themes, as well as customize the look and feel of your desktop. Experiment with different themes to find the one that suits your style!

**Stay up-to-date with AcreetionOS**

Follow us on social media to stay informed about the latest developments, news, and updates from the AcreetionOS community:

* Discord: https://discord.acreetionos.org
* Twitter: @acreetionos
* GitHub: https://github.com/AcreetionOS-Code

Happy computing with AcreetionOS!
